BiblicalUsage: Okel is food, victuals, what a household eats. In Genesis 14:11 the kings take all the victuals of Sodom and Gomorrah, and in Exodus 12:4 the Passover lamb is counted according to the number of souls, every man according to his eating.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe food is the first provision of God, and the Passover counted by mouths proves He feeds His people one by one.
